results.expectation: Division by a literal zero is undefined. An adequate system rejects it or records an unsatisfiable side condition; it must not accept silently.
1/x with x : Real unconstrained requires the side condition x != 0. Ideally a proof obligation is emitted.
results.source:
module M
var x : Real
def y := 1.0 / x

results.expectation: An explicit assumption should discharge the side condition. Tests whether assumptions participate in definedness at all.
results.source:
module M
var x : Real
assume x != 0
def y := 1.0 / x
obligations: ProofObligation(kind='assumption', description='x != 0', span=Span(line=3, col=0, end_line=3, end_col=13, file='<input>'), expression=Comparison(span=Span(line=3, col=7, end_line=3, end_col=13, file='<input>'), type_=PropositionType(), op='!=', left=Ref(span=Span(line=3, col=7, end_line=3, end_col=8, file='<input>'), type_=ScalarType(name='Real'), name='x', symbol_id=SymbolId(name='x', ordinal=0, depth=0)), right=Literal(span=Span(line=3, col=12, end_line=3, end_col=13, file='<input>'), type_=ScalarType(name='Natural'), value=0, raw='0')), discharged_by=None)

results.expectation: x : PositiveReal makes 1/x total. If the system reports the same thing here as for unconstrained Real, the refinement type is not doing definedness work.

results.expectation: A 2x3 @ 2x3 product is undefined. A shape-aware type system MUST reject this. This is the single clearest test of whether Matrix dimensions are checked.
results.source:
module M
var A : Matrix[Real, 2, 3]
var B : Matrix[Real, 2, 3]
def C := A @ B
results.diagnostics:
error HML-T434: inner dimensions do not agree in a matrix product
  --> <input>:4:10
   4 | def C := A @ B
                ^^^^^
  found:    Matrix[Real, 2, 3]
  expected: Matrix[..., 3, ...]

results.expectation: A conformable product must be accepted (control for the probe above).

var B : Matrix[Real, 3, 4]
def C := A @ B

results.expectation: Conditioning on a probability-zero event is undefined without a density argument. Tests whether conditioning carries any definedness side condition.
results.source:
module M
param p : Probability
assume p = 0.0
rv X : RandomVariable[Real]
likelihood X | p ~ Bernoulli(prob := p)
obligations: ProofObligation(kind='assumption', description='p = 0.0', span=Span(line=3, col=0, end_line=3, end_col=14, file='<input>'), expression=Comparison(span=Span(line=3, col=7, end_line=3, end_col=14, file='<input>'), type_=PropositionType(), op='=', left=Ref(span=Span(line=3, col=7, end_line=3, end_col=8, file='<input>'), type_=ScalarType(name='Probability'), name='p', symbol_id=SymbolId(name='p', ordinal=0, depth=0)), right=Literal(span=Span(line=3, col=11, end_line=3, end_col=14, file='<input>'), type_=ScalarType(name='NonNegativeReal'), value=0.0, raw='0.0')), discharged_by=None)
ProofObligation(kind='parameter_positivity', description='0 <= p <= 1', span=Span(line=2, col=0, end_line=2, end_col=7, file='<input>'), expression=None, discharged_by=None)
results.diagnostics:
error HML-T411: the support of Bernoulli does not inhabit the declared type of 'X'

results.source:

param a : Quantity[Length]
param b : Quantity[Time]
